paracetamol.sectionPath: How and when to take it
paracetamol.text: The usual dose is one or two 500mg tablets up to 4 times in 24 hours. Always leave at least 4 hours between doses.
Paracetamol is a common painkiller used to treat aches and pains. It can also be used to reduce a high temperature.
Taking 2 extra tablets by accident is unlikely to be harmful. Go to A&E straight away if you take more than 8 tablets in 24 hours.

salbutamol.text: Take 1 or 2 puffs when you need them, every 4–6 hours. Do not use more than 8 puffs in 24 hours.
Never take more than 8 puffs in 24 hours.

amoxicillin.text: The usual dose is 500 milligrams three times a day. The liquid is 250 mg/5 ml.
